concepts.name: political-directory
concepts.prompt: Portrait-led political directory with prominent search, province rail and source-backed coverage: 91 profiles, 71 deputies, 7 mayors. Only Mayer Mizrachi, Mayor of Panama City, Partido Popular; Stefany Peñalba, Mayor of Arraiján, Libre Postulación. Corrected first draft to remove invented people and affiliations.

concepts.name: comparison-first
concepts.prompt: Use case ui-mockup. ONE flat PNG desktop ORWELL Politics homepage concept, wide straight-on full-page screenshot, no devices, perspective, implementation or code. English only except official personal and party names. Reference 1 is brand reference only; create a substantially different information architecture below header. Preserve its official ORWELL mark exactly without redrawing it. Reference 2 is canonical Mayer Mizrachi portrait, reference 3 canonical Stefany Peñalba portrait. Use ONLY these two named people and exact portrait identities. Mayer verified label 'Mayor · Panama City', affiliation 'Partido Popular'. Stefany verified label 'Mayor · Arraiján', affiliation 'Libre Postulación'. Do not invent additional people, faces, election values, party affiliations, rankings or scores. Retain approved portraits, lean proportions, formal clasped hands, right shoulder nearest flag, flag overlap. Official assets cannot be approximated; do not invent new publisher or platform marks. Sophisticated editorial typographic hierarchy, restrained paper white/forest green/near black palette, excellent grid alignment, substantial whitespace, professional design reference quality, no gradients or generic SaaS marketing boxes. Concept 02: COMPARE FIRST. Adapt mature Zillow comparison interaction into a homepage. Hero is compact title 'See the differences. Follow the record.' beside a clear searchable profile field. Below, a generous two-person side-by-side preview with large portrait headers of Mayer and Stefany and neatly aligned rows 'Recorded office', 'Municipality', 'Party affiliation'. Correct values: both Mayor; Panama City vs Arraiján; Partido Popular vs Libre Postulación. Thin-rule sections and a clear 'Open full comparison' action. An elegant vacant third comparison slot 'Add a person' shows support for up to eight. Below, visual entry links 'Election results', 'Career records', 'Social archive', each using simple non-branded line symbols. Distinct composition from reference1: no green giant hero, no directory grid or province rail. Small margin label 'Homepage concept 02'.
